parameters.query: DELETE FROM active_purchases WHERE collecting_end < NOW() RETURNING purchase_number;
SELECT DISTINCT region_code::text, ktru_code FROM target_niches WHERE status = 'verified';

SELECT DISTINCT ON (ap.purchase_number)
  ap.purchase_number,
  ap.region_code::text,
  ap.max_price,
  ap.subject,
  ap.collecting_end,
  ap.customer_inn,
  sc.inn AS supplier_inn,
  sc.contracts_count::text,
  ROUND(sc.total_volume / 1000)::text AS total_volume_k,
  sc.regions_count::text
FROM active_purchases ap
LEFT JOIN supplier_candidates sc ON sc.ktru_code = ANY(ap.ktru_codes)
WHERE ap.first_seen_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '35 minutes'
  AND ap.status = 'new'
ORDER BY ap.purchase_number, sc.contracts_count DESC NULLS LAST;
UPDATE active_purchases SET status = 'alerted' WHERE status = 'new' AND first_seen_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '35 minutes';
